Attached: 1 image

Self-correction: the map quite likely _was_ #AI generated. I tried various #slop machines, and one stood out in generating similarly bad maps: #ChatGPT. In particular Uruguay, France and UK are placed hilariously badly, but most others aren't exactly great either. Similarity of the geographic mistakes that aren't shared with any other slop machine make me identify the original flyer's source to be ChatGPT.
